hero.headline: Carrd vs Pixpa
hero.subheadline: A side-by-side comparison for buyers, operators, and affiliate-content readers.

summary.best_for_a: Best for fast, ultra-affordable one-page landing pages, link-in-bio sites, and simple portfolios where speed and cost matter most.
summary.best_for_b: Best for photographers, designers, and small businesses that need a multi-page portfolio, built-in e-commerce, client galleries, and a CMS tailored to creatives.
summary.quick_take: Carrd and Pixpa target different needs: Carrd is the go-to when you want a single, fast, low-cost page that looks modern with minimal setup; it’s ideal for landing pages, simple portfolios, and link-in-bio pages. Pixpa is a fuller website platform built for creatives and small stores — it offers multi-page sites, galleries, client proofing, blogging, and integrated e-commerce. Choose Carrd for speed and price, Pixpa when you need features, galleries, and sales tools built in.

paragraphs: Choosing the right website builder comes down to what you need to accomplish. Do you want a frictionless one-page landing site you can launch in minutes, or a full creative website with galleries, client proofing, and an online store? Carrd and Pixpa sit on different ends of that spectrum.

Carrd focuses on simplicity, affordability, and speed — perfect for single-page projects and quick launches. Pixpa focuses on creatives and small businesses that need multi-page sites, photography-focused galleries, and e-commerce features. Read on to see which tool maps to your priorities and how each stacks up on templates, customization, commerce, SEO, and support.

data.headline: Carrd for one-page simplicity, Pixpa for creative businesses and online selling
data.summary: If your goal is a quick, inexpensive landing page or single-screen portfolio, Carrd keeps things simple and fast. If you need a polished multi-page site with galleries, blogging, client proofing, and built-in commerce, Pixpa is the more complete choice — slightly pricier but designed for creative professionals who want an all-in-one site.

items.question: Can I sell products with Carrd or Pixpa?
items.answer: Carrd supports simple payment widgets and third-party integrations for basic transactions, but it’s not built for full stores. Pixpa includes built-in e-commerce features to sell products, prints, and downloads with better store management.

items.question: Which platform is faster to launch?
items.answer: Carrd is typically faster to launch — you can create and publish a one-page site in minutes. Pixpa takes longer due to multi-page setup and additional features but offers a more complete website out of the box.

items.question: Is Carrd suitable for photographers?
items.answer: Carrd can work for a simple portfolio or link-to-gallery page, but photographers who need client proofing, high-quality galleries, and integrated sales are usually better served by Pixpa.

items.question: Do either platform include hosting?
items.answer: Yes — both platforms handle hosting as part of their service. Pixpa includes hosting and a CMS tailored to creatives, while Carrd hosts single-page sites as part of its plans.

items.question: Can I connect a custom domain?
items.answer: Both Carrd and Pixpa allow custom domains on paid plans, making it easy to brand your site and use your own URL.

items.question: Which is better for SEO and content marketing?
items.answer: For simple one-page SEO optimizations, Carrd is adequate. For ongoing content marketing, multi-page SEO, and blogging, Pixpa provides stronger tools and structure.
